name: Apart Garni Bergkristall
beschreibung: Apart Garni Bergkristall is a holiday home in Tirol. The accommodation is rented as a whole and offers plenty of privacy. The house has several bedrooms and a living area. The fully equipped kitchen allows self-catering. The amenities also include a garden or a terrace. The holiday home is a suitable starting point for exploring the surrounding area. Parking is available at the house.
